objective: 以一个validation-before-commit边界诚实接受unexpected fresh location，同时保留既有execution obligation与fail-closed policy

semantic_brief.summary: DesiredReality：fresh grounded或accepted Unknown observation经过完整准备后由一个同步Agent commit更新WorldBelief、允许的context/progress/Container evidence与typed transition。ClaimUnderTest：r5接受SettingsRoot belief但保留Display execution/path，并保持零自动动作。
core_points: ExistingEvidence：A/B已过独立gate；r5记录transition后Fail但未接受fresh belief
AllowedChange：新增immutable preparation与单一同步commit seam，迁移七类buyer
ForbiddenChange：authority边界与排除项均在正式forbidden中冻结
StopCondition：任何新mutable owner、context第三字段、跨await事务或既有policy变化立即返回Leader

change_principles: 新增immutable preparation value，包含candidate WorldBelief、validated current context、candidate context、可选既有progress replacement、可选Container observation acceptance与accepted ContainerTransition；不得成为mutable owner
所有可能失败的freshness、semantic grounding/Unknown、context/path一致性、classification、completeness/progress ref、exact-parent与continuity验证均在commit前完成
一个private synchronous Agent commit方法仅执行预验证后的Container evidence acceptance、`_belief`替换、`_activeContainerContext`替换、允许的`_branchProgress`替换与既有`_trace` append；方法体无await、I/O、action、recovery、policy或普通验证分支
Container保留其既有observation/history owner；允许增加一个internal total acceptance primitive，只接受Agent已完整预验证的fresh observation并机械更新CurrentObservation与可选viewport history，不执行identity/policy验证

r5 LeftContainer accepted frame必须把WorldBelief更新为fresh SettingsRoot/sequence，transition为PREMATURE_RETURN_TO_ACTIVE_PARENT，同时execution=Display、path=[SettingsRoot]、Display incomplete/progress不变并立即走既有fail-closed terminal
known non-parent、external exit与accepted Unknown均更新fresh WorldBelief并保留execution/path；classification不选择destination/action/recovery，external继续使用既有BoundaryRelation policy owner
accepted Unknown优先复用PlanRun已存在的post-action Reconcile acceptance路径并迁入同一prepare/commit seam；不得修改OpenWorld title-off/quiescence对null page的既有pending判定
authorized child entry与verified return通过相同prepare/commit seam保持现有授权、continuity、completeness、progress与action count；return commit先被完整准备，不允许half belief/context/progress/container mutation
same-Container acceptance通过相同seam更新fresh belief/Container evidence并发出SAME_CONTAINER；不改变quiescence分类、settle预算或viewport策略
拒绝的preparation只产生NO_COMMIT_FAIL_CLOSED diagnostic result或trace evidence，不改变WorldBelief、context、progress、Container observation、actions或terminal authority
保留Stage A/B与working tree所有其他用户变更；Stage A r5测试只允许把阶段性旧belief断言更新为Stage C冻结目标，不修改其action/fail-closed断言；不修改DriverHost、CLI/TUI、OpenSpec、docs或scope.write之外文件
acceptance: 结构测试证明恰好一个同步commit seam且无async/await/device/environment/traversal/recovery/action/policy调用，无新增mutable slot、latest transition cache、transaction owner或context字段
Container total acceptance primitive只有一个Agent commit callsite、无validation/policy分支，preserve既有Container owner并正确维护可选ViewportExplorationObservations

prepare rollback tests覆盖null/invalid context、stale sequence、classification rejection、wrong parent、failed continuity、missing progress/completeness ref；逐项证明belief/context/progress/Container CurrentObservation/trace accepted event均未部分变化

真实r5 replay证明terminal仍Failed、fresh seq28 WorldBelief=SettingsRoot、execution=Display、path=[SettingsRoot]、PREMATURE transition committed、Display obligation incomplete、Tap/Scroll count与Stage A相同且零recovery/re-entry/SystemBack
真实known non-parent、external foreground与accepted Unknown replay分别证明fresh belief honest、execution/path preserved、closed kind正确，且classification后零自动destination/action/recovery/completion
真实same/child/nested/verified-return/sibling replay证明equal deterministic input的action history、accepted observations、BranchProgress、GoalEvidence与terminal等价，只有typed transition/read evidence additive
同步AgentTests中仅因ordinary same现按合同推进CurrentObservation而过时的序号断言，并保留viewport失败frame不被旧Container接受、无redispatch与原progress不变的证明
同步ViewportIdentityContinuityTests中同类过时的最终/保留观测断言：accepted ordinary same须推进，stale/conflict viewport frame仍不得污染旧Container
同步Sibling stale-parent测试的journal比较索引：失败Step3 seq4必须与已接受Step2 seq4相等，并继续证明父progress不变与零redispatch
CompletenessRef仅引用现有Container/progress evidence，context/transition不复制boolean/subtree/progress map；BoundaryRelation与Recovery bookmark owner不变
Stage A 19、Stage B 7、Stage C focused、冻结69、dotnet build、C1-C15与git diff check全部通过，diff仅scope.write加既有Stage A/B文件
forbidden: 禁止新增或改变recovery、automatic re-entry、retry、completion、GoalEvidence、return eligibility、sibling selection、action authorization、FSM、Traversal或Agent strategy语义
禁止跨await保留prepared mutable transaction、引入lock/shared transaction owner、catch-and-continue partial commit或通过测试hook暴露生产内部
禁止把未ground/未accepted frame当作WorldBelief，禁止用未来frame倒推更早transition，禁止用parent observation证明child/subtree complete
escalation: 若一个atomic commit需要新增owner、第三种mutable location truth、跨module authority或Container acceptance不具备prevalidated total semantics，停止并返回REQUIRED_HUMAN_GATE
若r5 honest belief update会要求automatic recovery/re-entry或改变existing fail-closed terminal，返回Expected/Observed/Gap/FDP/Owner，不实现策略变化
若external/Unknown无法在现有WorldBelief contract中表达且必须新增protocol/wire truth，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW
若normal replay出现action、GoalEvidence、completeness、progress或terminal delta，回滚Stage C并向Leader报告First Divergence
